import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 510;
    static int nodes, edges, mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] f1_array = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] f2_array = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] g1_array = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] g2_array = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nodes = sc.nextInt();
        edges = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        // Compute binomial coefficients C[i][j]
        for (int i = 0; i <= nodes; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    C[i][j] = 1;
                } else {
                    C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize f1_array and g1_array
        f1_array[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++) {
            f1_array[i] = 0;
            g1_array[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long temp1 = ((long)f1_array[j - 1] * f1_array[i - j]) % mod;
                long temp2 = ((long)g1_array[j - 1] * f1_array[i - j] + (long)f1_array[j - 1] * g1_array[i - j]) % mod;
                f1_array[i] = (int)((f1_array[i] + temp1 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod);
                int temp = (int)((temp2 * (i + 1)) % mod);
                g1_array[i] = (int)((g1_array[i] + ((temp1 * (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) + temp) % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod);
            }
            f1_array[i] = (int)(((long)(i + 1) * f1_array[i]) % mod);
        }

        // Initialize g2_array and f2_array
        g2_array[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, edges); j++) {
                f2_array[i][j] = f2_array[i - 1][j];
                g2_array[i][j] = g2_array[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long temp_f = (i - k > 0) ? f2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] : 1;
                    f2_array[i][j] = (int)((f2_array[i][j] + temp_f * f1_array[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod);
                    long temp_g = (i - k > 0) ? f2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] : 1;
                    long g_part = ((temp_g * g1_array[k]) + ((i - k > 0) ? g2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] : 0) * f1_array[k]) % mod;
                    g2_array[i][j] = (int)((g2_array[i][j] + g_part * C[j][k]) % mod);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(g2_array[nodes][edges]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
